result:
All 14 queries ran and gave sensible answers against the files here. I did not check them against expected values.

- **Trimming:** qlang has no `trim`, so for stray spaces (N10, N14) I split on `" "` and joined with `""`. That would also remove spaces inside a tag or name, but none of the data has any.
- **N14:** it also assumes no requirement line starts with whitespace before a `-`.
- **N11:** its output was the only one printed as a literal rather than JSON, because I didn't pass `--raw`. N6 and N7 were run with `--raw` and printed literals too, with the N7 keys as keywords.

N1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | type | eq ::string) * (/email | split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort
N2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") * (:o / | {:c /customer/name :a (/lines * (mul /qty /unit_price) | sum | sub (o | at :discount | coalesce 0))}) | groupBy ~(/c) * (* /a | sum) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total (/1 | round 2)} | sort ~/total | reverse | take 2
N3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (at :assignee | coalesce {:login "unassigned"} | /login) | groupBy ~(/) * count
N4: [(at :dependencies) (at :devDependencies)] * coalesce {} | union /0 /1 | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys * keyword | sort
N5: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | :e / | {:enabledCount (e | count) :ports (e * at :port | vals | filter ~(ne null) | distinct | sort) :totalReplicas (e * (at :replicas | coalesce 1) | sum)}
N6: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") * (split "[" | /1 | split "]" | /0) | groupBy ~(/) * count | entries * {:service (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /service]) | take 2
N7: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(every ~(count | gt 0)) * {:r (/0 | lower) :v (mul (/2 | parseJson) (/3 | parseJson))} | groupBy ~(/r) * (* /v | sum | round 2)
N8: * {:u /user :t (/type | lower)} | :ev / | (filter ~(/t | eq "login") * /u | distinct) | minus (ev | filter ~(/t | eq "logout") * /u | distinct) | sort
N9: filter ~(at :salary | ne null) | groupBy ~(/dept) * (:g / | * /salary | sum | div (g | count) | round 1)
N10: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split ":" | drop 1 | join ":" | split "," * (split " " | join "" | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
N11: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","apple","date"] * lower | groupBy ~(/) * count | entries * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | filter ~(/count | gt 1) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word])
N12: /releases | filter ~(/draft | eq false) | filter ~(/prerelease | eq false) * {:tag /tag_name :downloads (at :assets | coalesce [] * (at :download_count | coalesce 0) | sum)} | sort ~(/downloads) | reverse | take 3
N13: filter ~(/category | lower | eq "tools") | :t / | {:count (t | count) :allPriced (t | every ~(at :price | if (eq null) ~(false) ~(gt 0))) :inStockNames (t | filter ~(at :stock | coalesce 0 | gt 0) * /name | sort)}
N14: lines * (split "#" | first) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "-" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") * (split "==" * (split " " | join "")) | filter ~(/0 | count | gt 0) * {:k (/0 | lower) :v /1} | indexBy ~(/k) * /v
